# Proto fields with no representation at all in a bulk greenfield KRM type.
#
# Distinct from missingfields.txt: that file records fields present in the CRD
# but not exercised by any fixture. A field here is absent from the CRD entirely -
# commented out, or never written - so nothing else in the repo can see it.
#
# This is a RATCHET, not a golden file. New entries fail even under
# WRITE_GOLDEN_OUTPUT=1 and are never written automatically; fixed drops are
# pruned. The list can only shrink.
#
# Every entry needs a reason=. Either implement the field, or say why it is
# intentionally absent.
#
# SANDBOX-ONLY. Not upstream policy.
